step: Layout revision E2: kpex 2.5D CC of r1_afe_ch and of the top cell without channels; wire and via resistance by the KLayout RNetExtractor; RC and C-only post-layout netlists
commands: python3 pex/pair_loads.py revE=<pex-20261021-b kpex_ch netlist> dev11=<kpex_ch netlist>,<kpex_top netlist> > pair_loads.json
method: MIM (36/0), Vmim and the TopMetal1 plate inside the MIM removed before kpex (no MIM model in kpex 0.3.12; plate capacitance is in the cap_cmim model)
top cell without channel instances: one dummy NMOS gate at each channel edge pin so that kpex keeps the nets (36 pins)
R: klayout.pex RNetExtractor, square counting, Metal1-Metal5 and Via1-Via4; sheet R 0.088 ohm/sq (Metal1 0.110), 9 ohm per via cut; geometry from the kpex lvsdb
ports: device terminals from layout/r1_afe_ports.json; Kron reduction per net (<= 60 ports); R > 1 Mohm dropped
loop-probe devices (XMN7/8, XMP7/8, XCC1/2, XCC1B/2B, XCX1/2, XMC1) and gate/bulk terminals stay on the main node of the net
C-only view: same capacitors, R nodes merged (comparison of R effects)
both channel instances use the same extracted channel
result: all six channel pairs and the four top-level pairs have |P - N| <= 3.4 fF (pair_loads.json). Supply R, pin to the farthest port: top level vdd 53.9 ohm (VCM1 divider head xrd1), 11.1 ohm (cosine channel pin), 6.2 ohm (sine channel pin); vss 42.3 ohm (divider foot xrd2), others <= 19.9 ohm; inside the channel vdd <= 203.5 ohm (gain-logic inverters xi1/xi2), vss <= 62.4 ohm (rnet_supply.json)
disposition: input to the post-layout campaigns r1afe-post2-e2-rc, r1afe-postbias-e2-rc, r1afe-postcm-e2-rc, r1afe-poststb-*
